articles.summary: LONG BEACH, Calif., Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- California Resources Corporation (NYSE: CRC) plans to release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Monday, November 2 nd after market hours. The Company will hold a conference call to discuss these financial results on Tuesday, November 3
articles.title: California Resources Corporation Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
